name: SCR, SNCR and CEMS for boilers
description: Post-combustion NOx control. SCR passes flue gas over a catalyst with a reagent, achieving up to 95% reduction on packaged systems; SNCR injects reagent into a 870-1,150 C window and gives 30-50% reduction alone or 65-75% with combustion controls. CEMS provides the continuous concentration and emission-rate measurement used to demonstrate compliance.
